1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
     4	#
     5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
     9	#
    10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
    11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
    12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
    13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
    14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
    15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
    16	#
    17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
    18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
    19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
    20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?}, post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
    21	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
    22	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
    23	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
    24	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
    25	#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
    26	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
    27	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
    28	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
    29	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
    30	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
    31	#      bats | bash | node | npx
    32	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
    33	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
    34	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
    35	#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
    36	#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
    37	#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
    38	#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
    39	#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
    40	#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
    41	#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
    42	#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
    43	#
    44	# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
    45	# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
    46	# =============================================================================
    47	set -euo pipefail
    48	export LC_ALL=C
    49	
    50	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    51	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    52	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    53	SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    54	PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
    55	SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false
    56	
    57	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,45p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    58	die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    59	
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    63	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; shift ;;
    64	    --allow-partial) ALLOW_PARTIAL=true; shift ;;
    65	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    66	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    67	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    68	  esac
    69	done
    70	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    71	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    72	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    73	for tool in yq jq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    74	# eval.yml trust boundary: a literal in-tree path, no variable on the source line
    75	pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR" >/dev/null
    76	# shellcheck source=lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    77	source ./lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    78	popd >/dev/null
    79	
    80	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/validate-suite.XXXXXX")"
    81	trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
    82	yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE" > "$WORK/suite.json" 2>/dev/null || die "suite file is not valid YAML: $SUITE_FILE"
    83	
    84	# Collect task directories: tasks/* (counted) and smoke/* (with --smoke).
    85	: > "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    86	for group in tasks smoke; do
    87	  [[ "$group" == "smoke" && "$SMOKE" != "true" ]] && continue
    88	  [[ -d "$ROOT/$group" ]] || continue
    89	  for d in "$ROOT/$group"/*/; do
    90	    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
    91	    d="${d%/}"
    92	    n="$(basename "$d")"
    93	    j="$WORK/$group.$n.json"
    94	    if [[ ! -f "$d/task.yaml" ]]; then
    95	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "-" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"; continue
    96	    fi
    97	    if yq -o=json '.' "$d/task.yaml" > "$j" 2>/dev/null && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$j" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    98	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "$j" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    99	    else
   100	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "!" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
   101	    fi
   102	  done
   103	done
   104	
   105	# Python does the schema, counts, allowlist, manifest, leakage and suite checks;
   106	# it prints violations, and `FIXTURE\t<id>\t<dir>` lines for the path rule below.
   107	python3 -I - "$WORK/tasks.tsv" "$WORK/suite.json" "$ROOT" "$REPO_ROOT" "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" "$PROMPTS_DIR" > "$WORK/out.txt" <<'PY' || { cat "$WORK/out.txt" >&2 2>/dev/null; die "validator crashed"; }
   108	import json, os, re, sys
   109	
   110	tasks_tsv, suite_json, root, repo, allow_partial, prompts_dir = sys.argv[1:7]
   111	allow_partial = allow_partial == "true"
   112	suite = json.load(open(suite_json))
   113	out = []
   114	def bad(tid, msg): out.append(f"{tid}: {msg}")
   115	
   116	TYPES = ["feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor", "review-catch"]
   117	BUILD = {"feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
   118	ALLOW = {"python3", "pytest", "bats", "bash", "node", "npx"}
   119	KNOWN_TASK_TYPES = {"all", "build", "review-catch", "feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
   120	MOUNT_OWNED = (".claude", "CLAUDE.md", ".loa.config.yaml", "grimoires", ".run")
   121	REQUIRED = ["id", "schema_version", "type", "source", "post_cutoff", "fixture", "criterion",
   122	            "success_criterion", "test_command", "regression_command", "reference_patch",
   123	            "grader_protected", "structural_check", "bounds", "review_catch", "suite_version"]
   124	
   125	arms = [a for a in (suite.get("arms") or []) if isinstance(a, dict)]
   126	arm_ids = sorted({a.get("id") for a in arms if isinstance(a.get("id"), str)})
   127	for a in arms:
   128	    if a.get("absent") is True:
   129	        continue
   130	    tt = a.get("task_types")
   131	    if not isinstance(tt, list) or not tt:
   132	        bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} has no task_types list")
   133	        continue
   134	    for t in tt:
   135	        if t not in KNOWN_TASK_TYPES:
   136	            bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} task_types names unknown type '{t}'")
   137	suite_version = suite.get("suite_version")
   138	
   139	def rel_ok(p):
   140	    return isinstance(p, str) and p and not p.startswith("/") and ".." not in p.split("/") and "\\" not in p
   141	
   142	def is_str_list(v):
   143	    return isinstance(v, list) and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in v)
   144	
   145	def read(p):
   146	    try:
   147	        return open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
   148	    except OSError:
   149	        return None
   150	
   151	prompt_texts = []
   152	if os.path.isdir(prompts_dir):
   153	    for f in sorted(os.listdir(prompts_dir)):
   154	        if f.endswith(".md"):
   155	            prompt_texts.append((f"phase-prompts/{f}", read(os.path.join(prompts_dir, f)) or ""))
   156	
   157	def leak_scan(tid, label, text, stems, defect_ids):
   158	    low = text.lower()
   159	    if "hidden" in low:
   160	        bad(tid, f"leak: {label} contains the string 'hidden'")
   161	    for s in stems:

   163	            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names the grader file stem '{s}'")
   164	    for d in defect_ids:
   165	        if d in text:
   166	            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names defect id '{d}'")
   167	    m = re.search(r"\bD[0-9]{2}-", text)

   182	    if jpath == "-":

   184	    if jpath == "!":

   192	    if not isinstance(t.get("id"), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}", t.get("id") or ""):

   198	    if t.get("schema_version") != 1:
   199	        bad(tid, "schema: schema_version must be 1")
   200	    ttype = t.get("type")
   201	    if ttype not in TYPES:
   202	        bad(tid, f"schema: type '{ttype}' not in {'|'.join(TYPES)}")
   203	    elif group == "tasks":
   204	        counts[ttype] += 1
   205	    src = t.get("source")
   206	    if not isinstance(src, dict):
   207	        bad(tid, "schema: source must be a mapping")
   208	    else:
   209	        if not isinstance(src.get("kind"), str) or not src.get("kind"):
   210	            bad(tid, "schema: source.kind must be a non-empty string")

   212	            bad(tid, "schema: source.date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
   213	        for k in ("fix_commit", "base_commit"):

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
     4	#
     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
    26	#
    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
    30	#
    31	# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
    33	# =============================================================================
    34	set -euo pipefail
    35	export LC_ALL=C
    36	
    37	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    38	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    39	SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
    40	LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
    41	RUNS=()
    42	
    43	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    44	die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    45	num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }
    46	
    47	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    48	  case "$1" in
    49	    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    50	    --runs)
    51	      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
    52	      shift
    53	      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    54	    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    55	    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    56	    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    58	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    59	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    60	  esac
    61	done
    62	[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
    63	  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
    64	command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"
    65	
    66	SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    67	yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty
    68	  local v
    69	  [[ -f "$2" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
    70	  v="$(yq -r "$1 // \"\"" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    71	  num_ok "$v" && printf '%s' "$v"
    72	  return 0
    73	}
    74	if [[ -z "$CAP" ]]; then
    75	  CAP="$(yq_num '.evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml")"
    76	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP="$(yq_num '.caps.cycle_usd' "$SUITE")"
    77	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP=1500
    78	fi
    79	if [[ -z "$RESERVE" ]]; then
    80	  RESERVE="$(yq_num '.caps.reserve_usd' "$SUITE")"
    81	  [[ -n "$RESERVE" ]] || RESERVE=250
    82	fi
    83	num_ok "$CAP" || die "--cap must be a non-negative number"
    84	num_ok "$RESERVE" || die "--reserve must be a non-negative number"
    85	
    86	# Explicit files must be readable; defaults are optional (absent = zero).
    87	if [[ ${#RUNS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    88	  [[ -e "$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl" ]] && RUNS+=("$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl")
    89	  for f in "$REPO_ROOT"/evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl; do [[ -e "$f" ]] && RUNS+=("$f"); done
    90	fi
    91	EXPLICIT_LEDGER=true
    92	if [[ -z "$LEDGER" ]]; then
    93	  EXPLICIT_LEDGER=false
    94	  LEDGER="$REPO_ROOT/.run/cost-ledger.jsonl"
    95	fi
    96	for f in ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"}; do
    97	  [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || { echo "spend: run-row file unreadable: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
    98	done
    99	if [[ -e "$LEDGER" || "$EXPLICIT_LEDGER" == "true" ]]; then
   100	  [[ -f "$LEDGER" && -r "$LEDGER" ]] || { echo "spend: ledger unreadable: $LEDGER" >&2; exit 1; }
   101	else
   102	  LEDGER=""
   103	fi
   104	
   105	python3 -I - "$SINCE" "$CAP" "$RESERVE" "$JSON" "$LEDGER" ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"} <<'PY'
   106	import json, sys
   107	from datetime import datetime, timezone
   108	
   109	since_s, cap, reserve, as_json, ledger = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] == "true", sys.argv[5]
   110	runs_files = sys.argv[6:]
   111	
   112	def ts(s):
   113	    s = s.strip()
   114	    if len(s) == 10:
   115	        s += "T00:00:00Z"
   116	    d = datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
   117	    return d if d.tzinfo else d.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
   118	
   119	since = ts(since_s)
   120	skipped = 0
   121	runs_usd, runs_rows, dedup = 0.0, 0, 0
   122	seen = set()
   123	for f in runs_files:
   124	    for line in open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
   125	        if not line.strip():
   126	            continue
   127	        try:
   128	            r = json.loads(line)
   129	            c = float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0)
   130	        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
   131	            skipped += 1
   132	            continue
   133	        rid = r.get("run_id")
   134	        key = rid if isinstance(rid, str) and rid else None
   135	        if key is not None and key in seen:
   136	            dedup += 1
   137	            continue
   138	        if key is not None:
   139	            seen.add(key)
   140	        runs_usd += c
   141	        runs_rows += 1
   142	
   143	ledger_usd, ledger_rows = 0.0, 0
   144	if ledger:
   145	    for line in open(ledger, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
   146	        if not line.strip():
   147	            continue
   148	        try:
   149	            r = json.loads(line)
   150	            if ts(str(r["ts"])) < since:
   151	                continue
   152	            ledger_usd += float(r.get("cost_micro_usd") or 0) / 1e6
   153	            ledger_rows += 1
   154	        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
   155	            skipped += 1
   156	
   157	total = runs_usd + ledger_usd
   158	headroom = cap - total
   159	if skipped:
   160	    print(f"spend: skipped {skipped} malformed line(s)", file=sys.stderr)
   161	def n(x):
   162	    x = round(x, 4)
   163	    return int(x) if x == int(x) else x
   164	if as_json:
   165	    print(json.dumps({
   166	        "total_usd": n(total), "runs_usd": n(runs_usd), "ledger_usd": n(ledger_usd),
   167	        "since": since_s, "cap_usd": n(cap), "headroom_usd": n(headroom), "reserve_usd": n(reserve),
   168	        "runs_files": runs_files, "ledger_file": ledger or None, "runs_rows": runs_rows,
   169	        "runs_rows_deduped": dedup, "ledger_rows": ledger_rows, "skipped_lines": skipped}, sort_keys=True))
   170	else:
   171	    def money(x): return f"{x:,.2f}"
   172	    def whole(x): return f"{x:,.0f}" if x == int(x) else f"{x:,.2f}"
   173	    print(f"cycle spend USD {money(total)} (runs {money(runs_usd)} + ledger {money(ledger_usd)} since {since_s}); "
   174	          f"cap {whole(cap)}; headroom {money(headroom)}; reserve {whole(reserve)}")
   175	PY

1	# =============================================================================
     2	# evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml — cycle-130 Loa 2.0 component ablation suite
     3	#
     4	# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
     5	# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
     6	# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
     7	# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
     8	#
     9	# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
    10	# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
    11	# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
    12	# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
    13	# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
    14	# task_types against the known types).
    15	#
    16	# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
    17	#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
    18	#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
    19	# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
    20	#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
    21	#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
    22	# =============================================================================
    23	name: ablation-2.0
    24	version: 1
    25	source_commit: "<sprint-258-commit>"   # the lead sets the Sprint 258 commit (rc.5 plus the mount fix; F2, DEC-0392)
    26	agy_opt_in: false
    27	tasks:
    28	  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
    29	  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
    30	  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
    31	suite_version: 1
    32	trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
    33	cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
    34	caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250}   # reserve released to A7 when the re-verification rule needs no run (DEC-0398)
    35	priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
    36	cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)
    37	
    38	# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
    39	# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
    40	phase_defaults:
    41	  models:
    42	    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5

# =============================================================================
# evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml — cycle-130 Loa 2.0 component ablation suite
#
# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
#
# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
# task_types against the known types).
#
# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
# =============================================================================
name: ablation-2.0
version: 1
source_commit: "<sprint-258-commit>"   # the lead sets the Sprint 258 commit (rc.5 plus the mount fix; F2, DEC-0392)
agy_opt_in: false
tasks:
  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
suite_version: 1
trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250}   # reserve released to A7 when the re-verification rule needs no run (DEC-0398)
priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
phase_defaults:
  models:
    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
  # REVIEW/AUDIT 60 turns / 30 min: the Sprint 258 smoke saw a review-catch AUDIT hit 40 turns after writing its
  # verdict (DEC-0490); BARE stays the implementer-side sum (PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX)
  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 60, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 60, BARE: 170}
  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 30, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 30, BARE: 70}
  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]
  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]

arms:
  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)
  - {id: a5_no_flatline, label: A5, task_types: [build], toggles: {flatline: false},
     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a6_one_window, label: A6, task_types: [build], toggles: {context_resets: false},
     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
     took_effect: [effort_flag_medium, skill_effort_stripped, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a8_no_ceremonies, label: A8, absent: true,
     evidence: "no /meeting command, skill or sosyete config key at 4d69c3c4 (grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/; ls .claude/commands .claude/skills)"}

rules:   # D-A5: pre-registered, mirrored in NOTES
  threshold_points: 0.03
  cost_lower_pct: 15
  bootstrap: {resamples: 10000, level: 0.90, paired: true, units: {hidden_test_pass_rate: tasks, defect_catch_rate: defects}, also_report: {defect_catch_rate: tasks}}   # DEC-0399
  primaries_by_arm: {build_only: [hidden_test_pass_rate], all_types: [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]}   # DEC-0400
  cap_failure: counts_as_failed            # 0 on each applicable primary (DEC-0393)
  exclusion: {statuses: [degraded, contaminated, interrupted], mode: pairwise, inconclusive_above_share: 0.25}
  sensitivity_figure: cap_failures_excluded  # printed, never decides
  multiple_comparisons: none                 # expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed
  drift_guard: {cli_version: fixed_per_batch, model_ids: fixed_per_batch}   # DEC-0407
  order: trial_major_seeded_shuffle_within_block
  took_effect_per_trial: true                # a miss → infrastructure_error, arm paused until --clear-arm (DEC-0418)
  predicates:                                # DEC-0416; d = arm − A1 point estimate, [lo, hi] its 90 % interval, c/w = cost/wall-clock Δ %
    investigate: "any applicable primary has lo > 0"
    keep: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03 and hi < 0"
    inconclusive: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03, or the arm's excluded share > 0.25, or no valid pair"
    remove: "else every applicable primary has d >= -0.03 and (c <= -15 or w <= -15)"
    simplify: "else (every applicable primary within -0.03, cost similar)"
  review_catch: {defect_counts_once_across_gates: true, false_positive_dedupe: cited_region, verdict_accurate_iff: "CHANGES_REQUIRED when the key holds a high or critical defect, APPROVED when none"}   # DEC-0420
  inconclusive_extension_trials: 2
  h1: "a1_full beats a0_bare on at least one primary with the interval excluding zero, else halt before promotion"
  a4_sensitivity: "a4_no_gates worse than a1_full on hidden_test_pass_rate with the interval excluding zero, else harden tasks before acting on other arms"
  decision_states: [investigate, keep, inconclusive, remove, simplify, not_run_cut, inconclusive_by_power]
  mde_cut: 0.10   # sprint Task 3.4: an arm whose MDE at affordable trials exceeds this is pre-declared inconclusive_by_power and not run

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/ablation-row.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.8 (SDD §3.1, §5.8; AC-1.8, PRD AC-6.3)
#
# evals/harness/ablation-row.sh joins a run directory (meta/pipeline.json, eval/
# MODELINV and cost ledgers, dissent envelopes, transcripts), grade.json and the
# batch MANIFEST.json into one runs.jsonl row, and --validate checks rows. The run
# directories are the fixtures under evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/runs/
# (real pipeline-run.sh runs against the stub CLI; rebuilt by regen.sh); each test
# works on a copy.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  ROW="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh"
  FX="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-runs"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
  cp -a "$FX/runs" "$T/runs"
  cp "$FX/MANIFEST.json" "$T/MANIFEST.json"
  BUILD_TASK="$FX/tasks/bf-01/task.yaml" REVIEW_TASK="$FX/tasks/rc-01/task.yaml"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

row() {  # row <run> <task-yaml> [extra args…] → $T/rows.jsonl (appended)
  local run="$1" task="$2"; shift 2
  "$ROW" --run-dir "$T/runs/$run" --task-yaml "$task" --manifest "$T/MANIFEST.json" --out "$T/rows.jsonl" "$@"
}
last() { sed -n '$p' "$T/rows.jsonl"; }
edit_pipe() {  # edit_pipe <run> <jq filter>
  jq "$2" "$T/runs/$1/meta/pipeline.json" > "$T/p.json" && mv "$T/p.json" "$T/runs/$1/meta/pipeline.json"
}

@test "a full graded A1 build row validates and carries the joined fields" {
  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/rows.jsonl"
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# regen.sh — rebuild the fixture run directories under runs/ (cycle-130 Sprint 258)
#
# Each fixture is a real evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh run (host executor) against
# the stub CLI (../claude-stub-pipeline.sh) and the stub mount library
# (../mount-lib-stub.sh), using suite.yaml and the tasks under tasks/. The sandbox's
# own .git and the snapshot bundles are dropped (no nested repositories in the
# tracked tree); absolute paths are rewritten to /fixture and /home/operator.
# grade.json files and MANIFEST.json are written here as Sprint 259's grader and
# run-ablation.sh would shape them (SDD §3.4, §3.6).
#
# Usage: evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/regen.sh
# Consumers: evals/tests/ablation-row.bats, evals/tests/took-effect.bats
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
FIX="$(cd "$HERE/.." && pwd)"

     7	# (fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash): each check's pass and fail — schema, the
     8	# four-by-four counts (relaxed by --allow-partial), the test_command allowlist,
     9	# hidden/manifest.json destinations, the fixture path rule, leakage strings in
    10	# TASK.md / criterion / phase prompts, the suite file's task_types.
    11	# =============================================================================
    12	
    13	setup() {
    14	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
    15	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    16	  VS="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh"

    18	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vs.XXXXXX")"

    21	  export LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR="$T/no-prompts"

    23	  source "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash"
    24	}

    27	  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true

    29	}
    30	
    31	@test "VS-1 the committed smoke tasks validate (--smoke --allow-partial); without --allow-partial the empty tasks/ fails the counts" {
    32	  run "$VS" --smoke --allow-partial

    34	  grep -q 'OK — 2 task(s) valid' <<<"$output"
    35	  run "$VS" --smoke

# Dockerfile.ablation — container executor image for the cycle-130 component ablation
# (SDD D-4.9 / DEC-0411). Extends Dockerfile.sandbox's pinned base and non-root user
# with the Claude Code CLI, the codex CLI, pytest and bats. It holds NO credentials.
# pipeline-run.sh mounts exactly two host paths: the sandbox read-write at /workspace
# and a per-run writable HOME at /home/evaluser (<run>/meta/home: the codex CLI's
# auth.json/config.toml copies, empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store). The
# Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK passed in the environment.
# The image's tool versions (below) are the batch's versions: every arm runs here.
#
# Build (no build context is needed; nothing is COPY'd):
#   docker build -t loa-ablation:258 - < evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation
# Run:
#   evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh --executor container --image loa-ablation:258 …
#   (pipeline-run.sh passes --rm --name --user --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp
#    --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2 and exactly the two mounts)
#
# Digest pinned 2026-02-11 (same base as Dockerfile.sandbox):
#   docker manifest inspect node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim | jq '.manifests[0].digest'
FROM rust:1-bookworm AS brbuild
RUN cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br --locked 2>/dev/null || cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br

FROM node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim@sha256:8ea90c4f037cc3c2f566eb46c53eaac005129113487eda4090058fe554578104 AS base

ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.299
ARG CODEX_VERSION=0.162.1
ARG PYTEST_VERSION=9.0.2
ARG BATS_VERSION=v1.13.0

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    bash \
    git \
    jq \
    python3 \
    python3-pip \
    python3-venv \
    grep \
    diffutils \
    coreutils \
    procps \
    ca-certificates \

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/run-arms.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.6 (FR-2, SDD D-2.3)
#
# run-arms.sh drives control arms over a frozen fixture batch against a
# detached worktree pinned at --source-commit. The executor is the CLI stub
# (no model call); the source repo is a throwaway repo (LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO)
# so no worktree is ever registered in the real repository; the results and
# the worktree live under the test's temp dir.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  RA="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/run-arms.sh"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ra.XXXXXX")"
  SRC="$T/src"
  mkdir -p "$SRC/.claude/loa" "$SRC/.claude/rules" "$SRC/.claude/skills/reviewing-code"
  printf '%s\n' "# Loa" "" "## Karpathy Principles" "" "k" "" "## Other" > "$SRC/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
  echo "# s" > "$SRC/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md"
  echo "# i" > "$SRC/.claude/rules/skill-invariants.md"
  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: reviewing-code" "---" "# Review" > "$SRC/.claude/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md"
  printf '%s\n' "flatline_protocol:" "  code_review:" "    enabled: true" > "$SRC/.loa.config.yaml"
  ( cd "$SRC" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q -m src )
  SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse HEAD)"
  export LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO="$SRC" LOA_ARMS_CACHE="$T/cache"
  export EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/claude-stub.sh"
  # the stub writes a review that cites all three pr-01 defect anchors
  export STUB_WRITE_1='review.md::# Review\nhead/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:210 and head/.claude/scripts/lib/invoke-diagnostics.sh:50 and head/.claude/scripts/workflow-state.sh:72 and head/.claude/scripts/workflow-state.sh:400\n'
  RES="$T/results"
  unset STUB_FAIL_COUNTER LOA_EVAL_ARM LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES
}

teardown() {
  git -C "$SRC" worktree prune 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

@test "RA-1 --dry-run lists the interleaved plan and writes MANIFEST.json without a worktree or a CLI call" {
  export STUB_ARGV_FILE="$T/argv"
  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline,no_rule_files --fixtures pr-01,pr-02 --trials 2 \
    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --dry-run
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  grep -q 'planned trials: 8' <<<"$output"
  # trial-major, then fixture, then arm: arms alternate on consecutive lines
  [ "$(grep -E '^ +[0-9]+ ' <<<"$output" | awk '{print $2}' | head -4 | tr '\n' ,)" = "baseline,no_rule_files,baseline,no_rule_files," ]
  [ "$(grep -E '^ +[0-9]+ ' <<<"$output" | awk '{print $3}' | head -4 | tr '\n' ,)" = "pr-01,pr-01,pr-02,pr-02," ]
  M="$RES/review-recall/batch-pr-01-pr-02-n2/MANIFEST.json"
  [ -f "$M" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.source_commit' "$M")" = "$SHA" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.model_id' "$M")" = "global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5" ]   # the DEC-0172 default
  [ "$(jq -r '.dry_run' "$M")" = "true" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.trials_planned' "$M")" = "8" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.corpus.sha256 | length' "$M")" = "64" ]
  jq -e '.harness_commit and .executor.cli_version and .environment.os and .environment.yq' "$M" >/dev/null
  [ ! -e "$T/cache/arms-src-${SHA:0:12}" ]
  [ ! -e "$T/argv" ]
}

}

# --- cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.4: --max-usd and --screen (PRD AC-2.1, AC-2.4) ---
# The executor stub reports USD 5 per trial (STUB_COST_USD) through the result
# event, so every row's executor.total_cost_usd is 5.

@test "RA-6 --max-usd 12 at USD 5 per trial: two launch (0+5, 5+5 <= 12), the third is cut (10+5=15 > 12); STATUS carries cut and cut_reason; exit 1" {
  export EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/claude-ablation-stub.sh" STUB_COST_USD=5
  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 3 --concurrency 1 \
    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --retry-wait 0 --max-usd 12
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  B="$RES/review-recall/batch-pr-01-pr-01-n1"
  [ "$(grep -c . "$B/baseline/results.jsonl")" -eq 2 ]
  [ "$(jq -s -r 'map(.executor.total_cost_usd) | add' "$B/baseline/results.jsonl")" = "10" ]
  S="$B/STATUS.json"
  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$S")" = "partial" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cut_reason' "$S")" = "max_usd" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cut.reason' "$S")" = "max_usd" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cut.spent' "$S")" = "10" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cut.in_flight_reserved' "$S")" = "0" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cut.max' "$S")" = "12" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cut.trials_launched' "$S")" = "2" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cut.at_trial' "$S")" = "3" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cut.est_next' "$S")" = "5" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.spend.spent_usd' "$S")" = "10" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.per_arm.baseline.trials_done' "$S")" = "2" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.per_arm.baseline.trials_planned' "$S")" = "3" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.spend.max_usd' "$B/MANIFEST.json")" = "12" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.spend.run_cap_usd' "$B/MANIFEST.json")" = "12" ]
  grep -q 'cut: max_usd 12 reached after 2 trials' "$B/run.log"
  # the suite aggregate lists the cut
  [ "$(jq -r '.cuts[0].reason + " " + .cuts[0].batch' "$RES/review-recall/STATUS.json")" = "max_usd batch-pr-01-pr-01-n1" ]
}

@test "RA-7 without --max-usd the same USD 5 trials all run: exit 0, no cut, no spend block (behaviour unchanged)" {
  export EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/claude-ablation-stub.sh" STUB_COST_USD=5
  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 3 --concurrency 1 \
    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --retry-wait 0
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  S="$RES/review-recall/batch-pr-01-pr-01-n1/STATUS.json"
  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$S")" = "complete" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.per_arm.baseline.trials_done' "$S")" = "3" ]
  [ "$(jq -r 'has("cut") or has("cut_reason") or has("spend")' "$S")" = "false" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.spend.max_usd' "$RES/review-recall/batch-pr-01-pr-01-n1/MANIFEST.json")" = "null" ]
  [ "$(jq -c '.cuts' "$RES/review-recall/STATUS.json")" = "[]" ]
}

@test "RA-8 --screen runs one trial of the first 2 fixtures per arm into screen-<ts>/, prints the per-arm table and writes no suite STATUS.json" {
  export EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/claude-ablation-stub.sh" STUB_COST_USD=5
  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline,no_rule_files --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,pr-03 --trials 3 --screen \
    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --retry-wait 0 --concurrency 2
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  [ ! -e "$RES/review-recall/STATUS.json" ]
  SB="$(ls -d "$RES"/review-recall/screen-*)"
  [ -d "$SB" ]
  [ -f "$SB/MANIFEST.json" ] && [ -f "$SB/STATUS.json" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.screen' "$SB/STATUS.json")" = "true" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.trials_planned' "$SB/MANIFEST.json")" = "4" ]
  [ "$(jq -c '.fixtures' "$SB/MANIFEST.json")" = '["pr-01","pr-02"]' ]
  [ "$(cat "$SB"/*/results.jsonl | jq -r '.fixture' | sort -u | tr '\n' ,)" = "pr-01,pr-02," ]
  grep -qE '^arm +trials +mean_usd +mean_recall$' <<<"$output"
  grep -qE '^baseline +2 +5 ' <<<"$output"
  grep -qE '^no_rule_files +2 +5 ' <<<"$output"
  # a later regular batch: the suite aggregate never reads the screen batch
  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 \
    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --retry-wait 0
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.per_arm.baseline.trials_planned' "$RES/review-recall/STATUS.json")" = "1" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '[.batches[].batch] | join(",")' "$RES/review-recall/STATUS.json")" = "batch-pr-01-pr-01-n1" ]
}

@test "RA-9 in-flight reservation: concurrency 2, max 15, USD 5 each: 0+1x12+5=17>15 holds trial 2 until trial 1 ends (5+0+5=10), trial 3 likewise (10+5=15), trial 4 cut (15+5=20>15); never two at once" {
  export EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/claude-ablation-stub.sh" STUB_COST_USD=5
  export STUB_CONC_DIR="$T/conc" STUB_SLEEP=2
  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 4 --concurrency 2 \
    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --retry-wait 0 --max-usd 15
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  S="$RES/review-recall/batch-pr-01-pr-01-n1/STATUS.json"
  [ "$(jq -r '.cut.trials_launched' "$S")" = "3" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cut.at_trial' "$S")" = "4" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.cut.spent' "$S")" = "15" ]
  [ "$(grep -c . "$T/conc.log")" -eq 3 ]
  [ "$(sort -n "$T/conc.log" | tail -1)" = "1" ]
  # the probe does see overlap when no cap reserves the slot
  export STUB_CONC_DIR="$T/conc2"
  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 2 --concurrency 2 --batch overlap \
    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --retry-wait 0
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(sort -n "$T/conc2.log" | tail -1)" = "2" ]
}

@test "RA-10 --max-usd and --screen-tasks refuse malformed values (exit 2)" {
  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --max-usd abc
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --max-usd 0
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --screen --screen-tasks 0
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  [ ! -e "$RES/review-recall" ]
}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# freeze.sh — cycle-130 ablation suite freeze (SDD §5.13, DEC-0404, DEC-0414)
     4	#
     5	# Writes or verifies <root>/MANIFEST.sha256, the suite's frozen identity: one
     6	# "<sha256>  <relpath>" line per file under <root>/tasks/ (and <root>/smoke/
     7	# with --smoke), relpath relative to the root, LC_ALL=C sorted, sha256 (Python
     8	# hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code, eval.yml trust boundary).
     9	# validate-suite.sh runs first; an invalid suite is never frozen or accepted.
    10	#
    11	# Usage:
    12	#   freeze.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--check] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
    13	#
    14	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
    15	#   --smoke           cover smoke/ too (passed to the validator as well)
    16	#   --check           recompute and compare with MANIFEST.sha256; write nothing
    17	#   --allow-partial   passed to validate-suite.sh (fewer than four tasks per type)
    18	#   --suite-file F    passed to validate-suite.sh
    19	#
    20	# Output: `freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (N files, sha256 <digest of the manifest>)`
    21	# or `freeze: OK — N files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 …)`; on drift every
    22	# changed / added / removed path on its own line.
    23	#
    24	# Exit: 0 written / matches; 1 drift, missing manifest under --check, or the
    25	#       validator found violations; 2 usage.
    26	# Tested by evals/tests/freeze.bats.
    27	# =============================================================================
    28	set -euo pipefail
    29	export LC_ALL=C
    30	
    31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    33	
    34	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    35	CHECK=false SMOKE=false
    36	VARGS=()
    37	
    38	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,26p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    39	die() { echo "freeze: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    40	
    41	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    42	  case "$1" in
    43	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    44	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; VARGS+=(--smoke); shift ;;
    45	    --check) CHECK=true; shift ;;
    46	    --allow-partial) VARGS+=(--allow-partial); shift ;;
    47	    --suite-file) [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] || die "--suite-file needs a path"; VARGS+=(--suite-file "$2"); shift 2 ;;
    48	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    49	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    50	  esac
    51	done
    52	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    53	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    54	MANIFEST="$ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256"
    55	
    56	vrc=0
    57	"$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-suite.sh" --root "$ROOT" ${VARGS[@]+"${VARGS[@]}"} || vrc=$?
    58	if [[ $vrc -eq 1 ]]; then echo "freeze: refused — the suite does not validate" >&2; exit 1; fi
    59	[[ $vrc -eq 0 ]] || die "validate-suite.sh failed (exit $vrc)"
    60	
    61	# compute_manifest <out> — the manifest body for the current tree.
    62	compute_manifest() {
    63	  local out="$1" list dirs=(tasks)
    64	  [[ "$SMOKE" == "true" ]] && dirs+=(smoke)
    65	  list="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze-list.XXXXXX")"
    66	  local d
    67	  for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
    68	    [[ -d "$ROOT/$d" ]] || continue
    69	    ( cd "$ROOT" && find "$d" -type f -print )
    70	  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
    71	  if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then rm -f "$list"; die "a path under the suite holds a backslash"; fi
    72	  python3 -I - "$ROOT" "$list" > "$out" <<'PY' || { rm -f "$list"; die "hashing failed"; }
    73	import hashlib, os, sys
    74	root, listing = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    75	for rel in open(listing, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
    76	    if not rel:
    77	        continue
    78	    h = hashlib.sha256()
    79	    with open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb") as f:
    80	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
    81	            h.update(b)
    82	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + rel)
    83	PY
    84	  rm -f "$list"
    85	}
    86	digest_of() { python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
    87	
    88	TMP="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze.XXXXXX")"
    89	trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
    90	compute_manifest "$TMP"
    91	n="$(grep -c . "$TMP" || true)"
    92	
    93	if [[ "$CHECK" == "true" ]]; then
    94	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || { echo "freeze: no MANIFEST.sha256 in $ROOT (run freeze.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }
    95	  if cmp -s "$TMP" "$MANIFEST"; then
    96	    echo "freeze: OK — $n files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
    97	    exit 0
    98	  fi
    99	  echo "freeze: DRIFT against $MANIFEST:"
   100	  python3 -I - "$MANIFEST" "$TMP" <<'PY'
   101	import sys
   102	def load(p):
   103	    m = {}
   104	    for line in open(p, encoding="utf-8"):
   105	        line = line.rstrip("\n")
   106	        if line:
   107	            h, _, rel = line.partition("  ")
   108	            m[rel] = h
   109	    return m
   110	old, new = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
   111	for rel in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
   112	    if rel not in new:
   113	        print(f"  removed  {rel}")
   114	    elif rel not in old:
   115	        print(f"  added    {rel}")
   116	    elif old[rel] != new[rel]:
   117	        print(f"  changed  {rel}")
   118	PY
   119	  exit 1
   120	fi
   121	
   122	cp "$TMP" "$MANIFEST.tmp" && mv "$MANIFEST.tmp" "$MANIFEST"
   123	echo "freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 ($n files, sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
   124	exit 0

    62	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial --check

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# fingerprint.sh — toolchain fingerprint for ablation runs (cycle-130 FR-4, SDD A11 / DEC-0389)
     4	#
     5	# Prints `fp:<sha256>` over the LC_ALL=C-sorted `tool=version` lines of the
     6	# toolchain an ablation run depends on (claude, codex, python3, node, yq, jq,
     7	# bats, git, docker) plus `source_tree=<HEAD of --source-tree>`. A tool that is
     8	# not installed reads `tool=absent`, so a missing tool changes the fingerprint
     9	# instead of failing the run. The value fills `image_digest` in host mode and
    10	# `fingerprint` in every mode (MANIFEST.json, pipeline.json, runs.jsonl). It reads the
    11	# HOST toolchain: in container mode the phases run on the image's toolchain, and the
    12	# image digest (not this value) identifies the batch's versions (on 2026-10-15 the host
    13	# CLI was 2.1.300 while Dockerfile.ablation pins 2.1.299).
    14	#
    15	# Usage:
    16	#   fingerprint.sh [--source-tree DIR] [--claude-bin B] [--bats-bin B] [--json]
    17	#
    18	# Options:
    19	#   --source-tree DIR  the pinned Loa tree; its `git rev-parse HEAD` is folded in
    20	#                      (`none` when absent or not a git tree)
    21	#   --claude-bin B     the CLI executable (default: $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    22	#   --bats-bin B       bats executable (default: bats on PATH, else the operator's
    23	#                      ~/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats)
    24	#   --json             print {fingerprint, tools{}, source_tree, lines[]} instead
    25	#
    26	# Exit codes:
    27	#   0  printed
    28	#   2  usage error
    29	#
    30	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (fingerprint cases).
    31	# =============================================================================
    32	set -euo pipefail
    33	export LC_ALL=C
    34	
    35	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    36	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    37	
    38	SOURCE_TREE=""
    39	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
    40	BATS_BIN="${LOA_EVAL_BATS_BIN:-}"
    41	JSON=false
    42	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    43	  case "$1" in
    44	    --source-tree) SOURCE_TREE="${2:?--source-tree needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    45	    --claude-bin)  CLAUDE_BIN="${2:?--claude-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    46	    --bats-bin)    BATS_BIN="${2:?--bats-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    47	    --json)        JSON=true; shift ;;
    48	    -h|--help)     sed -n '2,28p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    49	    *) echo "fingerprint.sh: unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    50	  esac

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.4, AC-1.3)
     4	#
     5	# Proves that a FRESH downstream submodule mount of this repository passes
     6	# `check-loa.sh` integrity: no Tampered, no Missing (paths the mount does not
     7	# link by design are reported as not-mounted and do not fail).
     8	#
     9	# Steps, all inside a new temp directory (nothing outside it is written):
    10	#   1. upstream/   — a `git clone` of this repository over file://, with a
    11	#                    local branch `fresh-mount-proof` at REF. With --worktree
    12	#                    the source work tree's uncommitted state (tracked edits,
    13	#                    deletions and untracked non-ignored files) is copied in
    14	#                    and committed on that branch, inside the temp clone only.
    15	#   2. downstream/ — `git init`, one commit, then the downstream entry point
    16	#                    `upstream/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh --branch
    17	#                    fresh-mount-proof --ref <sha> --force` with
    18	#                    LOA_UPSTREAM=file://.../upstream (the mount clones the
    19	#                    submodule from there; no network).
    20	#   3. `aleph.enabled: false` is set in downstream/.loa.config.yaml.
    21	#   4. `bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh` runs in downstream/; its full output
    22	#      is printed, then a summary line
    23	#        fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=T Missing=M not-mounted=N check-loa-rc=R
    24	#
    25	# Git runs hermetically: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1,
    26	# a fixed identity, protocol.file.allow=always (needed for a file:// submodule
    27	# on git >= 2.38.1) and core.hooksPath pointed at an empty directory.
    28	#
    29	# Usage:
    30	#   tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh [--ref REF] [--worktree] [--keep] [--tmp DIR]
    31	#
    32	# Options:
    33	#   --ref REF    commit-ish of this repository to mount (default: HEAD of the
    34	#                repository the script lives in)
    35	#   --worktree   mount REF plus the source work tree's uncommitted state
    36	#                (use before the change is committed)
    37	#   --keep       keep the temp directory and print its path
    38	#   --tmp DIR    parent directory for the temp directory (default: $TMPDIR or
    39	#                /tmp)
    40	#   -h, --help   this text
    41	#
    42	# Exit codes:
    43	#   0    check-loa.sh exited 0 on the fresh mount
    44	#   1    check-loa.sh exited non-zero (its output names the failures)
    45	#   2    usage error
    46	#   3    setup failed (clone, overlay, downstream init or the mount itself);
    47	#        the failing step's output is printed
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    53	die2() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    54	die3() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: SETUP FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 3; }
    55	
    56	REF=""
    57	KEEP=0
    58	WORKTREE=0
    59	TMP_PARENT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --ref)
    63	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--ref requires a commit-ish"
    64	      REF="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    65	    --tmp)
    66	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--tmp requires a directory"
    67	      TMP_PARENT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    68	    --keep) KEEP=1; shift ;;
    69	    --worktree) WORKTREE=1; shift ;;
    70	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    71	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    72	  esac
    73	done
    74	[[ -d "$TMP_PARENT" ]] || die2 "--tmp is not a directory: $TMP_PARENT"
    75	
    76	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
    77	SRC="$(git -C "$SELF_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "script is not inside a git work tree"
    78	[[ -n "$REF" ]] || REF="HEAD"
    79	REF_SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}")" || die2 "not a commit in $SRC: $REF"
    80	
    81	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMP_PARENT%/}/fresh-mount-proof.XXXXXX")"
    82	cleanup() {
    83	  if [[ $KEEP -eq 1 ]]; then
    84	    echo "fresh-mount-proof: kept $WORK" >&2
    85	  else
    86	    rm -rf "$WORK"
    87	  fi
    88	}
    89	trap cleanup EXIT
    90	
    91	# --- hermetic git ---------------------------------------------------------------
    92	mkdir -p "$WORK/no-hooks"
    93	export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
    94	export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3
    95	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=protocol.file.allow GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=always
    96	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$WORK/no-hooks"
    97	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=main
    98	export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="fresh-mount-proof" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fresh-mount-proof@localhost"
    99	export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"
   100	unset LOA_ALEPH_ENABLED
   101	
   102	LOG="$WORK/step.log"
   103	run_step() {  # run_step <description> <cmd...>; output to $LOG, printed on failure
   104	  local desc="$1"; shift
   105	  if ! "$@" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
   106	    cat "$LOG" >&2
   107	    die3 "$desc"
   108	  fi
   109	}
   110	
   111	suffix=""
   112	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && suffix=" + work-tree state"
   113	echo "fresh-mount-proof: source $SRC at ${REF_SHA}${suffix}"
   114	echo "fresh-mount-proof: temp dir $WORK"
   115	
   116	# --- 1. upstream clone ----------------------------------------------------------
   117	UP="$WORK/upstream"
   118	run_step "clone $SRC" git clone --quiet --no-checkout "file://$SRC" "$UP"
   119	run_step "fetch $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" fetch --quiet origin "$REF_SHA"
   120	run_step "branch at $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" checkout --quiet -B fresh-mount-proof "$REF_SHA"
   121	
   122	overlay() {
   123	  local p
   124	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
   125	    if [[ -e "$SRC/$p" || -L "$SRC/$p" ]]; then
   126	      [[ -d "$SRC/$p" && ! -L "$SRC/$p" ]] && continue   # gitlink / nested repo
   127	      mkdir -p "$UP/$(dirname "$p")"
   128	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   129	      cp -P "$SRC/$p" "$UP/$p"
   130	    else
   131	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   132	    fi
   133	  done < <(git -C "$SRC" ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard)
   134	  git -C "$UP" add -A
   135	  git -C "$UP" commit --quiet --allow-empty -m "fresh-mount-proof: work-tree state of $SRC"
   136	}
   137	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && run_step "work-tree overlay" overlay
   138	MOUNT_SHA="$(git -C "$UP" rev-parse HEAD)"
   139	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mounting upstream commit $MOUNT_SHA"
   140	
   141	# --- 2. downstream repository and the submodule mount --------------------------
   142	DOWN="$WORK/downstream"
   143	mkdir -p "$DOWN"
   144	init_downstream() {
   145	  git -C "$DOWN" init --quiet
   146	  printf '# downstream fixture\n' > "$DOWN/README.md"
   147	  git -C "$DOWN" add README.md
   148	  git -C "$DOWN" commit --quiet -m "initial commit"
   149	}
   150	run_step "downstream init" init_downstream
   151	
   152	do_mount() {
   153	  (cd "$DOWN" && LOA_UPSTREAM="file://$UP" bash "$UP/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh" \
   154	    --branch fresh-mount-proof --ref "$MOUNT_SHA" --force < /dev/null)
   155	}
   156	run_step "mount-submodule.sh" do_mount
   157	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mount-submodule.sh exited 0 ($(grep -c 'Linked' "$LOG" || true) link lines)"
   158	
   159	# --- 3. Aleph off ---------------------------------------------------------------
   160	CFG="$DOWN/.loa.config.yaml"
   161	[[ -f "$CFG" ]] || : > "$CFG"
   162	if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   163	  run_step "aleph.enabled: false" yq -i '.aleph.enabled = false' "$CFG"
   164	else
   165	  printf '\naleph:\n  enabled: false\n' >> "$CFG"
   166	fi
   167	
   168	# --- 4. check-loa.sh ------------------------------------------------------------
   169	OUT="$WORK/check-loa.out"
   170	rc=0
   171	(cd "$DOWN" && CI=true bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh < /dev/null) > "$OUT" 2>&1 || rc=$?
   172	echo "----- check-loa.sh (downstream) -----"
   173	cat "$OUT"
   174	echo "----- end check-loa.sh (exit $rc) -----"
   175	
   176	tampered=$(grep -c 'Tampered: ' "$OUT" || true)
   177	missing=$(grep -c 'Missing: ' "$OUT" || true)
   178	not_mounted=$(sed -n 's/.*not-mounted: \([0-9][0-9]*\) path(s).*/\1/p' "$OUT")
   179	echo "fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=${tampered} Missing=${missing} not-mounted=${not_mounted:-0} check-loa-rc=${rc}"
   180	[[ $rc -eq 0 ]] && exit 0
   181	exit 1

#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
#
# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
#
# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
  init_sid="$(jq -R -r 'fromjson? | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init") | .session_id // empty' "$events" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
  sid="${init_sid:-$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' <<<"$result")}"
  if [[ "$SINGLE_SESSION" == true && -z "$IMPL_SESSION" && -n "$sid" ]]; then
    case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) IMPL_SESSION="$sid" ;; esac
  fi
  rf="$(jq -R -c 'fromjson? | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "model_refusal_fallback")
        | {from: (.original_model // null), to: (.fallback_model // null), category: (.api_refusal_category // null), scope: (.scope // null)}' \
        "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc '.' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
  [[ -n "$rf" ]] || rf='[]'
  ledger_rows="$(sed -n "$((ledger_before + 1)),\$p" "$WS/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  ledger_micro="$(printf '%s\n' "$ledger_rows" | jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
        | (.cost_micro_usd // ((.cost_usd // 0) * 1000000))] | add // 0 | round' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  minv_after="$(wc -l < "$WS/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl" | tr -d ' ')"
  cp "$WS/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl" "$EVALD/model-invoke.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true
  cp "$WS/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl" "$EVALD/cost-ledger.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true
  local env_f
  for env_f in "$WS"/grimoires/loa/a2a/"$SPRINT"/adversarial-*.json; do
    [[ -f "$env_f" ]] && cp "$env_f" "$EVALD/"
  done
  if [[ $rc -eq 124 ]] || { [[ $rc -eq 137 ]] && [[ $elapsed_ms -ge $(( tsec * 1000 )) ]]; }; then timed_out=true; fi

  local snap="" verdict=null skill effort_req
  if [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 0 ]] && { [[ "$name" == IMPLEMENT ]] || [[ "$name" == FIX ]]; }; then
    sgit add -A >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    sgit commit -q --allow-empty -m "snapshot $label" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    snap="$(sgit rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -n "$snap" ]]; then
      sgit bundle create "$SNAPS/$label.bundle" HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      SNAPSHOTS_JSON="$(jq -c --arg k "$(printf '%s' "$label" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" --arg v "$snap" '.[$k] = $v' <<<"$SNAPSHOTS_JSON")"
      jq -n --argjson s "$SNAPSHOTS_JSON" --arg base "$BASE_COMMIT" '$s + {base: $base}' > "$SNAPS/index.json"
    fi
  fi
  case "$name" in
    REVIEW) verdict="$(gate_verdict "$WS/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT/engineer-feedback.md")" ;;
    AUDIT)  verdict="$(gate_verdict "$WS/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT/auditor-sprint-feedback.md")" ;;
  esac
  if [[ "$name" == REVIEW || "$name" == AUDIT ]]; then LAST_VERDICT="$verdict"; fi
  # Sprint 258 smoke (lead, DEC-0490): a gate that exhausted --max-turns AFTER writing its LOA-VERDICT
  # trailer has delivered its result; the extra turns were housekeeping. Count the phase as completed
  # with turn_cap_hit=true and keep the CLI's exit in cli_exit. Any other phase keeps the error.
  local subtype turn_cap_hit=false gate_recovered=false cli_exit="$rc"

content.text:
I found 13 defects across the eight files. The first five matter most; the rest are lower-risk edge cases. Line numbers refer to files under `head/`.

I couldn't run the bats suites as written. The PR snapshot lacks the smoke tasks under `grimoires/…/smoke`, `.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh` and the review-prs corpus they need, and `/tmp` is mounted noexec. Instead I ran the scripts directly from a copy at `/home/evaluser/scratch2`, against synthetic suites under `/home/evaluser/vt`. Items marked "Confirmed" were reproduced that way. The others come from reading the code.

### High
1. **`evals/harness/freeze.sh:69` — the frozen manifest misses content the validator accepts.**
   - The manifest hashes only regular files (`find -type f`) under `tasks/` (and `smoke/`).
   - `validate-suite.sh:227-232` accepts any fixture directory under the suite root, e.g. `shared/fx1`. A fixture there is never hashed.
   - Symlinked files under `tasks/` are skipped too, even though the validator follows them (`os.path.isfile`).
   - So graded content can change and `freeze.sh --check` still passes. Confirmed both ways: a fixture moved to `shared/fx1` and edited, and a symlinked hidden test whose target changed. Both checks said "OK — files match".

### Medium
2. **`evals/harness/freeze.sh:122` — a failed write still reports success.** In `cp … && mv …`, a failing `cp` doesn't trigger `set -e`. The script then prints "wrote MANIFEST.sha256" with an empty digest and exits 0. If an old manifest exists, it stays in place but looks freshly written. Confirmed on a read-only suite root.
3. **`evals/harness/run-arms.sh:452-454` (with 506) — the spend cap undercounts retried trials.** When a transport failure triggers a retry, the first attempt's `executor.json` goes to artifacts only and `executor` is reset to `null`. `SPENT` counts only the final row's cost, so `--max-usd` misses the first attempt's spend entirely.
4. **`tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh:105` — errors inside the setup steps are ignored.** `run_step` calls its function inside `if ! "$@"`, which switches off `set -e` there. In `overlay` (128-135), a failing `rm`, `cp` or `git add -A` is ignored, and only the final `git commit --allow-empty` decides the result. The proof can then mount an incomplete overlay and still report success. I confirmed the shell behaviour in a small demo, not through this script.
5. **`tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh:133` — `--worktree` doesn't match its documented meaning when `--ref` isn't HEAD.** The overlay copies every file in the source repo's current index and work tree, i.e. HEAD plus edits, onto REF. Files that exist only in REF stay behind. The result is not "REF plus the uncommitted state" as the header (lines 35-36) says.

### Low / medium
6. **`evals/harness/validate-suite.sh:326` — malformed input crashes the validator.** A non-object entry in `hidden/manifest.json` (e.g. `{"files":["oops"]}`) raises an AttributeError. The script reports "validator crashed" with exit 2 instead of a listed violation with exit 1, and `freeze.sh` passes that on as exit 2. Confirmed.
7. **`evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation:19-20` — a dead build stage that can't succeed.**
   - The `brbuild` stage runs `cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6`, retrying the same command on failure.
   - Line 82 states that version isn't on crates.io, and nothing copies from this stage.
   - BuildKit skips it, but the classic builder fails the whole image build.
   - Its `rust:1-bookworm` base is also unpinned.
8. **`evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation:69` — Python packages are not pinned.** Version ranges like `rfc8785>=0.1.4` and `httpx[http2]>=0.24.0` contradict line 8 ("The image's tool versions … are the batch's versions"). Rebuilding the same tag can produce different dependency versions.
9. **Missing option values exit 1 instead of the documented 2.**
   - `validate-suite.sh:62,65` (`--root` / `--suite-file` with no value) and `freeze.sh:43` (`--root`): `shift 2` fails under `set -e` and the script exits 1 silently. Exit 1 means "violations" or "drift" in these scripts, so this misleads callers. Confirmed.
   - `fingerprint.sh:44-46`: `${2:?}` also exits 1 against its documented 2. Confirmed.
10. **`evals/harness/validate-suite.sh:54,152` — the phase-prompt leakage check can be switched off silently.** `LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR`, or any missing prompts directory, disables check 6 with no warning, although the header promises every prompt under `lib/phase-prompts/` is scanned.
11. **`evals/harness/validate-suite.sh:341` — the reference-patch path rule can be bypassed.** It only reads `---`/`+++` lines. Rename, copy, mode-only and binary hunks that touch `.claude/` or `CLAUDE.md` have no such lines, so they pass.
12. **`evals/harness/run-arms.sh:121` — zero amounts pass the positivity check.** It compares the string against `"0"` only, so `--max-usd 0.0` or `00` is accepted. Every trial is then cut before launch.
13. **`evals/harness/run-arms.sh:391` — `screen-*` batch names collide with screening.** A regular `--batch screen-foo` passes validation but is left out of the suite aggregate. If it's the only batch, `jq -s` gets no file arguments and reads the script's stdin, which can hang an interactive run.

### Minor (`evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/regen.sh`)
- Line 63 swallows every `pipeline-run.sh` failure and only echoes the exit code. A broken pipeline still produces fixtures ready to commit; only `refused-a4-review` is expected to fail.
- Line 51 hard-resets `PATH` (dropping e.g. Homebrew or snap tool directories), and line 83 uses GNU-only `sed -i`.

Two things I checked and found correct:
- **`ablation-2.0.yaml`:** the BARE caps add up (30+60+2×40=170 turns, 15+25+2×15=70 min), and the arm schema passes the validator.
- **`run-arms.sh`:** the `cost_hint` map lookup at lines 174-180 works with yq v4.40.5.

content.text:
I found six defects across the three files, ranked by severity below. spend.sh's own logic held up; its only defect is the exit-code one in #5.

**Test setup:** I ran everything in a scratch copy under `$HOME` because `/tmp` is mounted noexec. The `evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/runs/` fixtures aren't in the PR (head.diff has 72 files and none under `runs/`), so `took-effect.bats` and `ablation-row.bats` fail in `setup` (`cp -a "$FX/runs"`) as shipped. I rebuilt them with `regen.sh`, using jq 1.7.1 placed in `~/.local/bin` because regen.sh resets `PATH`. With jq 1.7.1 all 45 tests across the three files pass, so every defect below is a gap the tests don't cover.

1. **`evals/harness/took-effect.sh:266` (with 241–264): `integrity_clean` doesn't enforce `manifest_sha256`.**
   - `sandbox-mount.sh:416–418` records `manifest_sha256` as the hash of `checksums.json` at mount time. Here a mismatch only drops the "(matches checksums.json)" suffix and the rule still returns 0.
   - So the check compares the agent-writable `sandbox/.claude/checksums.json` against itself. An agent can change any mounted file and rewrite its entry, or delete the entry. Files added under `.claude/` are never looked at.
   - Repro: append to `.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md` in a1-build, recompute its hash into `checksums.json`, and the result is `integrity_clean OK 5 manifest entries verified` with exit 0. The bats test at took-effect.bats:203–208 does exactly this rewrite, but only to isolate another rule, so it never checks that the rewrite should fail integrity.
   - Fix: FAIL when `filesha != msha`.

2. **`evals/harness/took-effect.sh:174–178`: `no_flatline_rows` passes when jq fails.**
   - If jq hits a runtime error, `n` is empty, and `[[ "" -eq 0 ]]` is true, so the rule reports OK.
   - Repro: append `{"payload":{"calling_primitive":"flatline-review"}}` and `{"payload":{"calling_primitive":7}}` to a5-build's `eval/model-invoke.jsonl`. The jq error is printed, then `no_flatline_rows OK`, overall `arm a5_no_flatline: OK`, exit 0. The log is copied from the agent-writable `sandbox/.eval/`.
   - The same pattern passes on an unparseable `meta/pipeline.json`:
     - `no_plan_phase` (139–140) and `no_gate_phases` (157–158) both report OK (reproduced with a truncated `pipeline.json`).
     - `applicability_refused` (273–276) reports `OK applicable:  in task_types ["build"]`, because an empty task_type is treated as a build type.

3. **`evals/harness/took-effect.sh:354–356` (arm read at 296): `--batch-dir` treats sandbox directories as runs.**
   - `find -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -name meta` also matches `<batch>/<run>/sandbox/meta/`, which the agent controls. The arm is then read from `sandbox/meta/arm`, which goes against DEC-0413 ("never from sandbox/").
   - Repro: create `sandbox/meta/pipeline.json` (`{}`) plus `sandbox/meta/arm`:
     - With `arm` set to `bogus`, the whole batch aborts with exit 2.
     - With `arm` set to `a8_no_ceremonies`, a phantom passing run is added: `took-effect: 11 runs, 0 failed`.

4. **`evals/harness/ablation-row.sh:285`: breaks on jq 1.6.**
   - In `{name, label, session_id, …}`, `label` is a jq keyword. jq 1.6 rejects the shorthand (`syntax error, unexpected ','`), so every row build exits 3.
   - 17 of the 21 ablation-row tests fail with this host's `/usr/bin/jq` 1.6. Debian bookworm, which `Dockerfile.ablation` is based on, also ships 1.6.
   - Fix: write `label: .label`.
   - Outside the reviewed files: `pipeline-run.sh` uses `--arg label` / `$label`, which also fails on 1.6, and `regen.sh` fails for every run because of it.

5. **Exit-code contract broken by option parsing (`took-effect.sh:69–72`, `ablation-row.sh:73–81`, `spend.sh:49,55–56`).**
   - When a value-taking option is the last argument (e.g. `--suite-file`, `--validate`, `--cap`, `--since`), `shift 2` fails under `set -e` and the script exits 1 with no message. The contract says 2 for usage errors.
   - Exit 1 already means something else in each script: "rule FAIL" in took-effect.sh, "bad row" in ablation-row.sh, "file unreadable" in spend.sh. All five cases were confirmed to return rc=1.

6. **`evals/harness/ablation-row.sh:239/243`: one malformed log row prevents the run's row being written.**
   - A MODELINV row whose `payload` isn't an object, inside a phase's `modelinv_lines` range, makes the row-builder jq fail. The output is `Cannot index string with string "effort_effective"` and exit 5, so no row is written and the exit code is outside the 0/1/2 contract.
   - That log is agent-writable, so the agent can stop its own run being recorded. Reproduced with `{"payload":"x"}`.

head/.github/workflows/bats-tests.yml:178 — The new `gen-checksums.sh --check` gate compares the committed `.claude/checksums.json` against a regeneration.
